_comment: The canned stage-1 (intake agent) reply for the refresh flow.
TRAIL_FAKE_AGENT points scripts/agent-run.mjs at this file, so every headless
agent exchange in the test server resolves with these bytes instead of
spawning `claude`. Everything after the agent — validateAgentDraft,
buildRaceJson, the course build, the merge and the diff — is the real code.
This is what the agent would say after re-reading the fixture race site
It agrees with the folder on disk everywhere EXCEPT the two cutoffs the
fixture site moved, which is what gives the refresh a diff to show:
non-empty `aid_stations` are required; `sun` is forbidden (the course build
computes it); aid stations may not carry lat/lon (the matcher snaps them);
race_climbs may not carry gain_ft/grade_pct/len_mi; a cutoff_h of 0 is
rejected (null means no cutoff). Keys beginning with _ are ignored.
name: Dry Wash 50K

aid_stations.name: Saguaro Flat
aid_stations.notes: water only — no crew access on this course

coach_notes.terrain: Dry desert singletrack with two sustained but short climbs; footing is loose decomposed granite on every descent.
coach_notes.climate: Hot and dry from mid-morning on; shade is the exception, not the rule.
coach_notes.altitude: Nothing on this course is high enough to matter — this note exists so the fixture proves features.altitude hides it even when the prose is written.
coach_notes.key_demands: Heat management and a disciplined first climb.
